Hi, I’m Chinmayi.

Cybersecurity and AI Engineer

Building intelligent, secure, and meaningful digital experiences.

I am a 3rd-semester B.Tech CSE student at REVA University and currently working as an Artificial Intelligence Intern at Abscissa.dev.

In my 3rd sem, I learned how to set up and use VS Code for different programming languages, including C, C++, Python, and Java. I gained practical experience with debugging, code formatting, problem-solving, and using Git and GitHub for version control. I also learned how to collaborate with others using Live Share, review code with GitLens, and solve coding problems on LeetCode. Additionally, these activities helped me improve my logical thinking, teamwork, documentation, and time-management skills while building a well-organized GitHub portfolio.
